senses.gloss:
पूज् पूज्, cl. 10. P. पूजयति (ep. also
cl. 10. A. पूजयते, and cl. 1. P. पूजति),
अपूपुजत्, पूजयितुम्, to adore, honour, revere,
reverence, worship, respect, receive with honour, re-
ceive hospitably; to take notice of, regard; to honour
with, present with (e. g. रत्नैः पूजयेद् एनम्,
he should honour him with a present of gems).

पूजक, अस्, इका, अम्, honouring, worshipping,
respecting, a worshipper (often used in comps.; cf.
देव-प्˚).

पूजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reverencing, honouring; wor-
shipping.

पूजन, अम्, n. reverencing, honouring; wor-
shipping, worship, respect; showing attention (to a
visitor), treating with respect or hospitality; an object
of reverence; (ई), f., N. of a female bird a friend of
king Brahma-datta; a hen-sparrow.

पूजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be revered or honoured,
entitled to homage; venerable, honourable; to be
worshipped, adorable; (आ), f., N. of a female bird
a friend of king Brahma-datta.
पूजयान, अस्, आ, अम्, honouring, reverencing.

पूजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured or wor-
shipped, deserving honour or worship, venerable.

पूजयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, honouring, worshipping,
a worshipper.
पूजयित्वा, ind. having honoured or worshipped.

पूजा, f. honour, worship, respect, culture, rever-
ence, veneration, homage to superiors or adoration
of the gods.
—पूजा-खण्ड, N. of a Buddhist work.
—पूजा-प्रदीप, अस्, m. ‘lamp of worship,’ N. of
a work.
—पूजार्ह (˚जा-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, worthy
of reverence or honour, worshipful, venerable, re-
spectable, sacred.
—पूजा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, enjoying
honour or distinction.

पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, respected, rever-
enced; worshipped, adored; frequented; recom-
mended; acknowledged; endowed.
—पूजित-पू-
जक, अस्, इका, अम्, honouring the honoured or what
is honoured (by others).

पूजिल, अस्, आ, अम्, venerable, respectable, wor-
shipful; (अस्), m. a god, deity.

पूज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured, honourable,
respectable, venerable; fit for or deserving adoration,
worshipful; (अस्), m. a father-in-law.
—पूज्य-ता, f.
or पूज्य-त्व, अम्, n. venerableness, honourableness,
the being entitled to honour.
—पूज्य-पूजा, f.
honouring those worthy of honour.
—पूज्यपूजा-
व्यतिक्रम, अस्, m. neglecting to honour those
worthy of honour,

पूज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being honoured or re-
spected; being adored or worshipped.
